newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU says too early to send envoys back to Iran.
newsitem.headline: EU says too early to send envoys back to Iran.

text.p: European Union foreign ministers decided on Monday that the situation was not yet right for members of ther 15-nation bloc to send their ambassadors back to Iran.
"We noted that the conditions for the return of our ambassadors...have not yet been met," Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo told a news conference.
The EU withdrew its ambassadors from Tehran in April following the finding of a German court that Iran had been involved in the nmurder of Kurdish Iranian opposition leaders in Berlin.
At the same time the EU suspended its so-called critical dialogue with Iran under which it was attempting to bring Iran closer to the West through talks.
A move later by the EU to send its ambassadors back to Tehran was suspended when Tehran refused to accept the German envoy.
